description: This file defines the TenantObject class, which encapsulates tenant information in the Eclipse Hono system. It includes methods for managing tenant properties, trust anchors, adapter configurations, resource limits, defaults, and tracing configurations.

classes.name: TenantObject
classes.description: Represents tenant data with properties, trust anchors, adapter configurations, resource limits, and tracing settings.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Adds a property to the tenant object, enabling dynamic property assignment.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant's unique identifier.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant's unique identifier.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the tenant is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the tenant.

methods.name: setTrustAnchor
methods.description: Defines a trust anchor by associating a CA's public key and subject DN.

methods.name: getTrustAnchor
methods.description: Returns the first trust anchor, deprecated in favor of getTrustAnchors().

methods.name: getTrustAnchors
methods.description: Retrieves the set of trust anchors for the tenant, constructing them from JSON if necessary.

methods.name: getTrustAnchorForPublicKey
methods.description: Creates a TrustAnchor object from JSON properties containing public key and subject DN.

methods.name: getAdapterConfigurationsAsMaps
methods.description: Returns the adapter configurations as a list of maps.

methods.name: getAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Returns the adapter configurations as a JsonArray.

methods.name: getAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the configuration for a specific adapter type.

methods.name: setAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Sets the list of adapter configuration maps.

methods.name: setAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Sets the adapter configurations from a JsonArray.

methods.name: addAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Adds an adapter configuration based on a JsonObject.

methods.name: isAdapterEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific adapter type is enabled for this tenant.

methods.name: getMaxTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Gets the maximum seconds to wait before disconnect for a specific adapter type.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a TenantObject with specified tenantId and enabled property.

methods.name: from ( Boolean )
methods.description: Creates a TenantObject with only the enabled property.

methods.name: newAdapterConfig
methods.description: Creates a new adapter configuration JsonObject with type and enabled status.

methods.name: getResourceLimits
methods.description: Returns the resource limits object for this tenant.

methods.name: setResourceLimits (JsonObject)
methods.description: Sets resource limits from a JsonObject.

methods.name: setResourceLimits (ResourceLimits)
methods.description: Sets resource limits from a ResourceLimits object.

methods.name: getMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum message size in bytes.

methods.name: setMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum message size, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Gets default properties for devices of this tenant.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default properties for devices.

methods.name: getTracingConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant's tracing configuration.

methods.name: setTracingConfig
methods.description: Sets the tenant's tracing configuration.
